title: Fifteen years
logline: Fifteen. The corn, at the desk, 3 AM. The Legacy in the lot, two days old, already with a tarp in the back. The corn was bought with the car's first tank money.

panels.composition: The desk, 3 AM. Corn. WOOD. BARNABY beneath. Through the glass door: the Legacy under the sodium light, one hubcap, the tarp. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel night clerk with a tray of corn at the desk, an old dog beneath, and through the glass door a faded green 1993 station wagon with one hubcap under a sodium light, razor-sharp ink, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: The corn. Beside it, #1 — he's brought the yellowed first strip to the desk and propped it against the bell.

image.prompt: close-up of a paper tray of corn beside a yellowed old comic strip propped against a motel desk bell

balloons.text: Fifteen years. I have a car that burns oil and a desk that hums and a dog that's thirteen. Eat the corn.

image.prompt: a man speaking to an old dog beneath a motel desk while holding a tray of corn, wry

panels.composition: The lobby from the door — the reverse of every other anniversary panel. The man at the desk, small, facing us. Corn. Dog. #1. The car behind the reader.

image.prompt: a motel lobby seen from outside the glass door at night, a small figure at the desk facing the viewer with a tray of corn, an old dog beneath, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel, no words
image.notes: Reversed: every other anniversary is back-turned. This one faces the door. The reader stands where the car is.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Faces the door. 'Eat the corn.' The Legacy two days old.
